title: goEV
tagline: A decentralized market for EV Charging Stations, providing a better experience for EV owners.

prizes.placement: 🥉 DeGate — Best Solution That Contributes to one of 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals
prizes.title: DeGate

description:
nowadays EV stations are all centralized, you have to have a subscription with some so that you can use the service, this is not idea for example if you are doing long road trips and also you do not want to download the apps of every single provider. is a big problem !

apart from that, there are some web2 solutions which charge high fees to their users, they are like aggregators of EV providers and their fees can go as high as 20%
how_its_made:
Dapps architecture : 
1. App System UI we’re using Next.js , Apollo (GraphQL) , Wagmi ( Ethereum) , Leaflet for maps
2. App System Server we’re using Go & Express to manage our charge station
3. Ethereum blockchain: Solidity , Hardhat , ERC20

sponsor tech:
OpenZepplin, Ethereum Fundation, Polygon,
